ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous block localized on the distal-lateral margin of the left lobe; high-frequency white mottled clusters and linear streaks distributed across the medial and lateral regions of the right lobe against a low-intensity background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 115 degrees and a shallow depth-to-width bounding-box ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular pixel deviations (serrations) along the right lobe boundary; lower-frequency variations on the left lobe with distinct macro-indentations near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the leading edges; trailing edges exhibit complex, multi-modal concavity with irregular interruptions.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular pixel clusters concentrated on the right lobe surface and along the distal margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive three-dimensional barnacle encrustations (Coronula spp. morphology) visible on the distal tips of both lobes; significant irregular tissue loss and notches along the continuous trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely dense, high-relief calcified clusters localized at the furthest terminal points of both fluke lobes, significantly altering the outer geometric profile.
